title: bromus rigidus subsp. maximus
intro: Bromus rigidus subsp. maximus, commonly known as giant wildrye, is a perennial grass native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its use in reducing inflammation, alleviating respiratory issues, and supporting immune function. The health benefits of Bromus rigidus subsp. maximus are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
